summary: squeez@1.42.1 postinstall fetches and executes remote content from raw.githubusercontent.com
details: package.json declares a postinstall hook ("postinstall": "node install.js") that runs on npm install. install.js imports child_process, https, fs, and os; branches on process.platform; reads os.homedir(); and performs https.get calls to raw.githubusercontent.com (lines 42, 76, 104). The lifecycle script fetches remote content from a mutable third-party host and combines those network fetches with filesystem reads and child_process primitives at install time, matching the shape of an install-time dropper rather than a normal build step. No wheel/prebuilt or first-party publisher-owned distribution channel is used; the fetched content on raw.githubusercontent.com can be changed at any time by the repository owner without any change to the published npm package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
